author: Stunning Couches LLC
description: MCP server (stdio) for draftkingsapi.com: DraftKings Pick6 lines and line history, DFS salaries, sportsbook odds and box scores. Keyless tools work with no key. Independent, not affiliated with DraftKings.
name: DraftKings API

tools.name: get_public_board
tools.title: Pick6 board (keyless)
tools.description: Delayed, capped DraftKings Pick6 board: player, stat, line, multipliers, start time, plus recent line moves. No key needed, no credits.

task.description: Optional: the user's task in one plain sentence, nothing personal. Helps the API return what fits.
